events.verdict: Paul (SAS) extends his forearm into Bridges' (CHA) body and delivers contact as he defends the driving shot attempt.
Salaun (CHA) jumps from point A to point B and makes contact with Fox (SAS), which affects his driving shot attempt.
Fox (SAS) steps forward into Ball's (CHA) path and delivers body contact during his drive that affects his SQBR.  This contact occurs prior to, and causes, the traveling violation committed by Ball.
Fox (SAS) moves alongside Ball's (CHA) path as he establishes himself in his path, and he absorbs the marginal contact that occurs as Ball moves forward towards the basket.
Ball (CHA) and Paul (SAS) briefly engage and disengage as Ball releases away to receive the pass.

Vassell's (SAS) right hand is on the ball, and the ensuing contact to Salaun's (CHA) head that occurs while his hand is in contact with the ball is marginal.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Vassell (SAS) cleanly ties up Salaun (CHA) as they pursue the rebound, and a jump ball is correctly whistled.

Fox (SAS) re-establishes himself inbounds prior to making contact with the ball.  There is no clear and conclusive camera angle that shows if the ball touches the baseline after Ball (CHA) deflects the ball away from Fox.
Ball (CHA) cleanly dislodges the ball from Fox (SAS).
Ball (CHA) and Fox (SAS) come together at the same spot, and incidental foot to foot contact occurs during the drive.

Replay review of the foul called on Wembanyama (SAS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Wembanyama cleanly blocks Diabate's (CHA) shot attempt. Play resumes with a jump ball at center circle because neither team was deemed to have imminent possession at the point of interruption.
Ball (CHA) establishes himself in Sochan's (SAS) path and absorbs the contact to his upper body during the screen.
Saluan (SAS) and Vassell (SAS) briefly engage and disengage off-ball during the inbound.
After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (no basket) was confirmed.  Fox (SAS) does not release his shot attempt prior to the expiration of the game clock.
